paragraphs.zh: 不同PH值下对析出的纯化环磺酮的氰化物杂质含量分析，处理方法：重排反应结束后，蒸馏脱溶后取产品5g溶解在20％含水乙醇中，升温至60℃，加入1g硅藻土保温一小时后热过滤，控温滴加10％稀盐酸调节PH分别为2、3、4、5，逐渐降温至15℃，过滤得纯化环磺酮。得以下数据：
paragraphs.en: Analysis of the cyanide impurity content of the purified tembotrione that precipitated out at different PH values. Treatment method: after the rearrangement reaction was finished, the solvent was removed by distillation, then 5 g of the product was dissolved in 20% aqueous ethanol, the temperature was raised to 60 C, 1 g of diatomaceous earth was added and held for one hour, then hot filtration; 10% dilute hydrochloric acid was added dropwise under temperature control to adjust the PH to 2, 3, 4 and 5 respectively, the temperature was gradually lowered to 15 C, and filtration gave purified tembotrione. The following data were obtained:
paragraphs.notes: Taken verbatim from this page's text layer and checked character by character against the pixels. The text layer's internal spacing is preserved exactly, including the full-width percent signs in the twenty percent aqueous ethanol and ten percent dilute hydrochloric acid phrases. The four printed lines are wraps of a single paragraph and are joined with no separator. The patent writes PH in capitals throughout rather than pH, and that casing is kept. This paragraph is the prose that introduces the table printed at paragraph 0051, and it is the only place on the page that states the four PH values under test.

Cells are as printed; no cell was computed, averaged, rounded, interpolated or filled. Inside the table cells the printed layout leaves small gaps between Latin and Chinese glyphs, a side effect of justifying text inside a narrow column; those gaps are typesetting artifacts and are not recorded as spaces. The percent sign inside the table cells and headers is drawn narrow, matching the half-width percent of the surrounding Latin digits, and is clearly narrower than the full-width percent sign used in the body prose of paragraphs 0050 and 0053 on the same page, so it is transcribed as a half-width percent sign. This is the unlabelled table of Example 5 results: it carries no printed table caption or number of any kind on the page, and its identity rests only on its position immediately after the prose of Example 5. It has four data rows, test batches 16 to 19, which matches the four PH values 2, 3, 4 and 5 named in the prose of paragraph 0050; the table lists them in descending order 5, 4, 3, 2 while the prose enumerates them ascending, which is recorded in discrepancies and not reconciled here. Its second column is the PH value, where the Table Four table at paragraph 0048 has the treatment method, and its fourth column header reads after crystallisation, not after treatment as in Table Four; the two headers are different and are kept distinct rather than merged. The whole table fits on this page and does not continue onto p10. Test batches 18 and 19 carry the same printed value 25 in the fourth column and the same printed 99 percent in the fifth; that repetition is exactly as printed and was checked twice at high magnification. The header cells recorded above were read from the header row printed on this page, not carried over from another page and not positional placeholders. One character differs from the same header as reported on p05: this page writes the first column header with the trial character, giving trial batch, where the first table of the series on p05 is reported to print it with the experiment character, giving experiment batch. Both name the same column and the difference was checked at seven times magnification on this page. It is recorded rather than normalised to the p05 spelling. One observation that is visible only on this page, recorded as an observation and not as a conclusion: test batches 18 and 19 differ in the variable under test, PH 3 against PH 2, yet print the same residual cyanide content, 25 ppm, and the same reduction, 99 percent. Taken at face value the patent's own data for this pair says that going from PH 3 down to PH 2 buys nothing measurable, while paragraph 0016 and claim 1 both specify a PH below 3. Nothing on this page resolves that, and nothing here is inferred from it.

paragraphs.zh: 向2L三口烧瓶加入的2‑氯‑3‑(2 ,2 ,2‑三氟乙氧基)甲基‑4‑甲磺酰基苯甲酰氯231 .9g，1 ,2‑二氯乙烷1L，15℃搅拌。缓慢加入氯化亚砜237 .9g。常温反应0.5h，升温至75℃，保温3h。中控检测原料含量≤0.2％，在‑0.098mP下减压脱溶至85℃，脱去溶剂以及过量的氯化亚砜。重新加入新的1,2‑二氯乙烷500ml和三乙胺200g，投入1,3环己二酮92g和丙酮氰醇0.5g，40℃保温6h。检测反应完全。过滤出三乙胺盐，减压浓缩得红棕色固体环磺酮产品，环磺酮产品中加入40％含水甲醇，升温至60℃后加入5g活性炭保温1h，热过滤，搅拌转
paragraphs.en: Into a 2 L three-necked flask were added 231.9 g of the 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl chloride and 1 L of 1,2-dichloroethane, and the mixture was stirred at 15 C. 237.9 g of thionyl chloride was slowly added. Reaction at room temperature for 0.5 h, then the temperature was raised to 75 C and held for 3 h. In-process control found the starting material content to be no more than 0.2%. Under -0.098 mP the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure up to 85 C, removing the solvent and the excess thionyl chloride. Fresh 1,2-dichloroethane, 500 ml, and triethylamine, 200 g, were added again, and 92 g of 1,3-cyclohexanedione and 0.5 g of acetone cyanohydrin were charged, then held at 40 C for 6 h. The reaction was checked and found to be complete. The triethylamine salt was filtered off and the mixture concentrated under reduced pressure to give the tembotrione product as a red-brown solid. To the tembotrione product was added 40% aqueous methanol, the temperature was raised to 60 C, then 5 g of activated carbon was added and held for 1 h, hot filtration, stirring and transfer
paragraphs.notes: Taken verbatim from this page's text layer and checked digit by digit against the pixels at high magnification. Every one of the text layer's spacing oddities is preserved exactly as extracted: the spaced locants in the trifluoroethoxy name, the spaced decimal points in 231 .9g and 237 .9g, and the spaced locant in the first mention of 1 ,2-dichloroethane, against the unspaced forms 1,2-dichloroethane 500ml and the 1,3-cyclohexanedione 92g later in the same paragraph. The hyphens in the chemical names and in -0.098mP are the non-breaking hyphen U+2011 as the text layer emits them, not ASCII hyphens, and are left as such. Full-width percent signs appear in the 0.2 percent in-process limit and in the 40 percent aqueous methanol, and are kept. The paragraph is cut off mid-sentence at the foot of the page and continues onto p10; only what is printed on this page is transcribed. Translated literally, and two things in the literal reading are flagged here rather than silently repaired. First, the charged starting material is named as the benzoyl chloride, the acid chloride, and yet thionyl chloride is then added to it and excess thionyl chloride is later stripped off, which is what one does to the benzoic acid; p03 of this document describes the route as the benzoic acid reacting with thionyl chloride to give the benzoyl chloride. The same wording appears in the Example 1 paragraph on p04, so this is the patent's own consistent wording and not a scan artifact, and it is not corrected here. Second, the pressure is printed as mP, which is not a pressure unit in normal use and most plausibly means MPa; it is left exactly as printed. The cyclohexanedione is written without the customary hyphen after its locants, as printed.

discrepancies.what: The fifth column of both tables on this page is the percentage reduction in cyanide impurity content, so it should follow from the two ppm columns printed in the same row. In every row on this page it does not. The printed cells are recorded unchanged; the percentages below marked computed were derived here from the printed ppm pairs purely to state the size of the disagreement, and no printed cell was recomputed, corrected or replaced. The column header is not on this page for the first table in the series; it was supplied by the coordinating read of p05, where the first table of the series prints it.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Table Four at paragraph 0048: row 14 goes from 1029 ppm to 38 ppm, which is 96.31 percent computed against 97 printed with no percent sign; row 15 goes from 1029 ppm to 46 ppm, which is 95.53 percent computed against 94 percent printed. The table at paragraph 0051: batch 16 goes from 1238 ppm to 82 ppm, which is 93.38 percent computed against 88 percent printed; batch 17 goes from 1238 ppm to 46 ppm, which is 96.28 percent computed against 98 percent printed; batches 18 and 19 both go from 1238 ppm to 25 ppm, which is 97.98 percent computed against 99 percent printed, in both rows. Four of the six printed figures are low against the computation and two are high, so the disagreement is not a single consistent rounding rule or a single consistent offset.
discrepancies.text_says: The prose on this page, paragraphs 0050 and 0053, states no reduction percentage at all, so nothing on this page settles which figure is intended. The fifth column header, printed on both tables on this page and also on the first table of the series on p05, reads cyanide impurity content reduction percent, and gives no derivation, no basis and no rounding rule.

discrepancies.what: The last cell of row 14 of Table Four is printed as a bare number with no percent sign, while every other cell in that column on this page carries one.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Row 14 of the table at paragraph 0048 prints 97; row 15 of the same table prints 94 percent.
discrepancies.text_says: The column header of that table reads cyanide impurity content reduction percent, so a percentage is what the column holds; the prose says nothing about it.

discrepancies.what: The prose of Example 5 and the table of Example 5 results list the four PH values in opposite order. The number of data rows does match the number of PH values named in the prose, four; only the order differs. Recorded, not reconciled.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The table at paragraph 0051 lists PH 5 for batch 16, then 4 for batch 17, then 3 for batch 18, then 2 for batch 19, descending.
discrepancies.text_says: Paragraph 0050 states that the dilute hydrochloric acid was added to adjust the PH to 2, 3, 4 and 5 respectively, ascending.

discrepancies.what: The table at paragraph 0051 carries no printed caption, unlike the other tables in this document, so its identity rests on its position immediately after the prose of Example 5 rather than on any table number.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The table image printed at paragraph 0051 has no caption above, below or beside it.
discrepancies.text_says: Paragraph 0050 ends by announcing that the following data were obtained, which introduces a table but does not number or name it.

discrepancies.what: Example 6 charges thionyl chloride onto a material named as an acid chloride, and strips excess thionyl chloride afterwards, which is the operation one performs on the corresponding acid. Recorded, not corrected, because the same wording appears in Example 1 on p04 and so is the patent's own.
discrepancies.drawing_says: There is no drawing on this page; the comparison is between the prose of paragraph 0053 on this page and the route as described in the body text on p03.
discrepancies.text_says: Paragraph 0053 charges 231.9 g of the 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl chloride and then adds 237.9 g of thionyl chloride, while p03 describes the preparation as the corresponding benzoic acid reacting with thionyl chloride to give that benzoyl chloride.
